ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left is a watch dial with 1 to 12, with the numbers arranged in clock-face order. On the right is a black circular disk, with two circular holes on the disk, and both holes are at the same radius position as the dial numbers; currently the upper-right hole corresponds to 1 on the clock face, and the lower-right hole corresponds to 5 on the clock face. Reasoning: When the black circular disk is placed on the dial and rotated, the angular interval between the two holes will not change. In the figure, the two holes are separated by 4 clock positions from 1 to 5. Therefore, no matter how it is rotated, the two numbers that can be seen at the same time must also be separated by 4 clock positions. If the upper hole that originally faces 1 is rotated to face 5, then the other hole will also rotate accordingly to 9, which is 4 positions after it. Therefore, the two numbers that can be seen at the same time are 5 and 9.

method.method_draft: Describe the image first: the left figure is a 12-number watch dial, and the right figure is a black disc with two round holes positioned at the same radial distance as the dial numbers. In the shown alignment, the upper hole is around the 1-position and the lower hole is around the 5-position. Use the text statement that the black disc is placed over the watch dial and then turned. Because turning the disc preserves the angular separation between its two holes, count the gap between the two holes on the clock: from 1 to 5 is four hour-steps clockwise. Therefore, after any rotation, the two visible numbers must also be four hour-steps apart. Rotate the disc so the upper hole that was at 1 aligns with 5; then the lower hole, four steps later, aligns with 9. Hence the two numbers visible together are 5 and 9.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：左边是一个有 1 到 12 的手表表盘，数字按钟面顺序排列。右边是一个黑色圆盘，圆盘上有两个圆孔，两个孔都在与表盘数字相同的半径位置；当前上方偏右的孔对应钟面上的 1，下面偏右的孔对应钟面上的 5。

推理：黑色圆盘被放在表盘上并转动时，两个孔之间的角度间隔不会改变。图中两个孔从 1 到 5 相隔 4 个钟点位置。因此无论怎么转，能同时看到的两个数字也必须相隔 4 个钟点位置。若把原来对着 1 的上方孔转到对着 5，那么另一个孔也会随之转到 4 个位置之后的 9。因此可以同时看到的两个数字是 5 和 9。
